cautions.t: Check identity and compatibility at the bedside
Use only sodium chloride 0.9% in the line
Emergency group O negative where uncross-matched

adverse_effects.t: Transfusion reactions (febrile, allergic, haemolytic), circulatory overload, TRALI, hyperkalaemia and hypocalcaemia with massive transfusion

monitoring.t: Observations before, at 15 minutes and regularly during transfusion
